title: Pipeline Desiloing — Connect Isolated Engines to Production Pipelines
brief: Replace 'self-contained, no imports' architecture in 5/7 pipelines with lazy-load pattern. Replace inline Kienzle/Taylor/MC with real engine calls. Fix collision detection stub.

units.title: Establish lazy _getEngine() pattern
units.description: Proven by PostProcessorPipelineEngine. Create shared LazyEngineLoader utility for all pipelines. Eliminates circular-dep excuse.

units.title: Desilo PrintToProgramPipelineEngine
units.description: Replace inline Kienzle/Taylor/deflection with lazy calls to real engines. Add CrossCamRecommender for strategy.

units.title: Desilo PartGeometryPipelineEngine
units.description: Replace _computeSfStrategy() with CrossCamRecommender. Replace inline physics with engine calls.

units.title: Desilo SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine
units.description: Replace inline 500-trial MC with MonteCarloEngine. Replace inline Weibull with StochasticToolLifeEngine. Wire CrossCamRecommender and MachiningPlaybook (currently doc-only references).

units.title: Desilo CAMKernelOrchestratorEngine
units.description: Replace selectStrategy() switch with CrossCamRecommender. Replace collision stub (always returns 0) with SweptVolumeCollisionEngine.

units.title: Desilo TurningPrintToProgramEngine
units.description: Replace inline Kienzle turning with TurningForceEngine. Add turning strategy via ToolpathStrategyRegistry (40+ turning strategies).

units.title: Desilo UnifiedCAMPipelineEngine
units.description: Add CrossCamRecommender before AdaptiveToolpathRouter. Add StochasticChatter + StochasticDeflection. Add MachiningPlaybook.

units.title: Desilo DesignToFloorPipelineEngine
units.description: Replace inline monteCarloRisk() with MonteCarloEngine + UncertaintyPropagationPipeline chain.

units.title: Shared MC/Weibull infrastructure
units.description: Ensure MonteCarloEngine and StochasticToolLifeEngine are THE single source. No more inline reimplementation.

units.title: Fix collision detection stub
units.description: Replace CAMKernelOrchestrator stub (always 0 collisions) with SweptVolumeCollisionEngine. Add stock model awareness.

units.title: Dispatcher integration
units.description: All desiloed pipelines surface enriched results through dispatchers.

units.title: Desiloing verification tests
units.description: 50+ tests verifying all pipelines call real engines.
exit_conditions: No inline physics in any pipeline

units.title: Wire fixture/setup engines
units.description: MultiSetupFeasibilityChainEngine, SetupTransitionEngine, SetupSheetEngine, MultiSetupPlannerEngine into P2P.

units.title: Wire DFM/quality engines
units.description: DFMFeedbackEngine in P2P Stage S2 before program gen. QualityPredictionEngine for Cpk output. SPCProcessCapabilityEngine.

units.title: Wire energy engines
units.description: GCodeEnergyOptimizerEngine on P2P output. SpecificCuttingEnergyEngine for energy-per-part estimates.

units.title: Wire geometry/feature recognition engines
units.description: FeatureRecognitionEngine in P2P Stage S2 for auto-classification. EngagementGeometryEngine for accurate engagement. RestMachiningEngine for auto rest passes.
